title: ISO 1328-2:2020 — Cylindrical gears — ISO system of flank tolerance classification — Part 2
locator: Official catalogue abstract: definitions and allowable values of double flank radial composite deviations for individual cylindrical involute gears and sector gears; reviewed and confirmed 2025
notes: This is a gear component measurement/classification source, not a rotary table axis acceptance standard. It does not provide gear design guidance or recommend tolerances; scope limits include three or more teeth and reference diameter up to 600 mm. Do not treat double-flank composite results as interchangeable with all single-flank or assembled-system backlash tests. Full text is not archived.
